title_sq: Vile individuale ne shitje, prane TEG!
description_sq:
Vile individuale ne shitje, pjese e nje rezidence te re prane TEG!
- Rezidence e re, me nje vendodhje ideale, ne kodrat prane TEG, ku qetesia, ajri i paster dhe facilitetet per nje jetese komode jane kryefjala.
- Vila eshte pjese e nje komuniteti te mirefillte, nje projekti rezidencial qe ofron gjithcka ne brendesi te tij, bar - restorant, fushe tenisi, palester, pishine, kend lojrash per femijet, hapsira te dedikuara per banoret, etj.
- Vila ka nje pozicion ideal ne brendesi te kompleksit, me pamje te lire, privatesi dhe nje siperfaqe banimi prej 203m2, te organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes + ambientin e gatimit/ngrenies disi te vecuar, nje dhome per pritjen e miqve (qe mund te sherbej edhe si dhoma e 4 e gjumit), nje lavanderi/depo/dhome pastrimi-tharje, 3 dhoma gjumi ne katin e dyte, njera prej te cilave me garderobe dhe tualet, 3 tualete ne total, korridoret qe bejne shperndarjen e ambienteve.
Siperfaqja e truallit eshte 330m2, duke ofrofuar nje kopesht ne pjesen e prapme te viles, i askesueshem ngado, si dhe oborrin perpara ne te cilen mund te ndertohet pishina sipas deshires si dhe dy poste parkimi ne hyrjen kryesore te viles.
-Perpos vendodhjes ideale, faciliteteve qe ofron ne brendesi te saj, Rezidenca njihet dhe per cilesine e larte te punimeve, duke nisur nga hidroizolimi, izolimi termik/akustik, instalimet elektrike/hidraulike, rifiniturat, fasada e jshtme, infrastruktura, etj.
- Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!
title_en: Individual villas for sale, near TEG!
description_en: Individual villa for sale, part of a new residence near TEG! - New residence, with an ideal location, in the hills near TEG, where peace, clean air and facilities for a comfortable life are the key words. - The villa is part of a real community, a residential project that offers everything inside it, bar - restaurant, tennis court, gym, swimming pool, playground for children, dedicated spaces for residents, etc. - The villa has an ideal position inside the complex, with a free view, privacy and a living area of 203m2, organized in the living room + somewhat separate cooking/dining area, a guest room (which can also serve as the 4th bedroom), a laundry/storage/cleaning-drying room, 3 bedrooms on the second floor, one of which with wardrobe and toilet, 3 toilets in total, the corridors that distribute the premises. The surface of the land is 330m2, offering a garden at the back of the villa, accessible from all sides, as well as the front yard in which a swimming pool can be built as desired, as well as two parking spaces at the main entrance of the villa. -In addition to the ideal location, the facilities it offers inside, the Residence is also known for the high quality of the works, starting from waterproofing, thermal/acoustic insulation, electrical/hydraulic installations, refinishing, exterior facade, infrastructure, etc. - For more information, contact us!
